title: TypeError when applying a null coupon at checkout
root_cause: applyCoupon dereferences coupon before checking it exists when the coupon code expired between cart load and payment.

title: TransferWorker times out calling ledger-service
message: Request to ledger-service timed out after 5000ms (POST /v2/entries)
root_cause: ledger-service connection pool exhaustion under month-end batch load; worker retries amplify it.

title: Hydration mismatch on /dashboard
message: Hydration failed because the initial UI does not match what was rendered on the server.
root_cause: Greeting renders the local time with new Date() on both server and client.

title: JWT signature validation fails after signing-key rotation
message: invalid signature: no key found for kid 'k-2026-09'
root_cause: JWKS cache is not refreshed after rotation; tokens signed with the new kid are rejected until restart.

title: Orders report query exceeds 30s
message: canceling statement due to statement timeout
root_cause: Missing composite index on orders(tenant_id, created_at) for the monthly report.
